$comment: The Three Helms (Q1.5, Rhea): a Copilot-app-only mechanic. Three orders sailed in your own ship; at each buoy you pick the helm (the session mode) that fits, and the run acts out the mode: Interactive (you choose each heading), Plan (review her plan: approve, exit, or suggest changes), Autopilot (she sails it end to end). The courses, buoys and headings are the game's; the modes' names, the orders (01 §Modes, the use-case column), the review's options (worded as the app words them, 02 §Exercise: Start a Session from a Branch), Rhea's lines and the readouts are this file's.

interactive.name: The Blue Marks
interactive.text: Thread the blue marks with me. I want you involved the whole way, calling every turn.

plan.name: The Reef Passage
plan.text: Take her through the reef passage. The approach matters here, so we see the route before we move.

autopilot.name: The Run Home
autopilot.text: Take her home to your berth on the east arm. It’s well defined, and the outcome’s clear.

review.label: Exit plan mode and I will prompt myself

orderHints.interactive: “Involved the whole way” is the course’s use case for the mode that works with you step by step.
orderHints.plan: “The approach matters” is the course’s use case for the mode that plans first.
orderHints.autopilot: “Well defined, with a clear outcome” is the use case for the mode that runs end to end.

text.headingPrompt: Which way, Captain? You choose the heading.
text.askSteer: Thread the blue marks with me, one mark at a time
text.waitingHeading: Waiting on you: which way to mark {n}?
text.askReview: Chart a course through the reef passage
text.askRevise: Suggest changes: keep her clear of the Shoal
text.askAuto: Take her home to the east-arm berth
text.hintAtBuoy: We’re at the buoy. Press E to hear Rhea’s order.
text.hintSail1: Sail up to the buoy with the {flag} flag, Captain. The compass points the way.
text.hintSail2: Follow the gold marker on the compass to the {flag} flag, then press E beside it.
text.hintSail3: Here, the crew will take her up to the buoy for you.
text.hintOrder1: Read Rhea’s order. Do you want a say at every step, a plan to review first, or a clear job to hand over?
text.hintHeading: Your call, Captain: either heading works. In Interactive, you direct each step.
text.hintReview1: Read the plan line by line before you choose. Is any leg risky?
text.hintReview2Revised: The plan’s clear of the Shoal now. Which option sails it?
text.hintReview2: Leg 2 crosses the Shoal. Which option lets you fix the plan?
text.hintReview3: I’ve asked her to steer round the Shoal.
text.hintRun: Rhea’s got the helm. Watch how this mode works.
